after.zh: A ∧ B → C 和 A → (B → C) 可以互相改写，这叫<wiki-ref to="currying"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: A ∧ B → C and A → (B → C) can each be rewritten as the other. This is <wiki-ref to="currying"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: 拼接写成「⟨□, □⟩」：拿到 a 和 b，拼成一对交给 p。
hint.en: Join is “⟨□, □⟩”: given a and b, make a pair and give it to p.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: 拆解写成「□.1」「□.2」：拿到的 a 是一对，p 要的却是一个一个。
hint.en: Split is “□.1” and “□.2”: the a you get is a pair, but p wants them one at a time.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

tasks.answer: p.elim (fun a => Or.inr a) (fun b => Or.inl b)

hint.zh: 分情况写成「□.elim (fun _ => □) (fun _ => □)」，补充写成 Or.inl、Or.inr：每种情况各贴到新「或者」的哪一边？
hint.en: Cases is “□.elim (fun _ => □) (fun _ => □)”, Add alternative is Or.inl or Or.inr: in the new “or”, which side does each case go?

hint.en: Explosion is “False.elim □”; q used on p is the contradiction.
